scope: Original fictional, open-world claim-support regression challenge. Labels concern the supplied passages only, not outside knowledge. Exact citations are shared within matched triples and do not by themselves imply claim support. Public disclosure makes this a regression challenge, not an unseen benchmark or evidence of improved general reasoning.

passages.text: In the fictional Cinderfen nursery, some of the seedlings in tray Orra have striped leaves. Some seedlings in that same tray do not have striped leaves. Every seedling in tray Orra has a clay marker.

cases.claim: No seedling in tray Orra has striped leaves.

citations.quote: In the fictional Cinderfen nursery, some of the seedlings in tray Orra have striped leaves. Some seedlings in that same tray do not have striped leaves. Every seedling in tray Orra has a clay marker.

cases.label: contradicted
cases.rationale: The explicit existence of striped seedlings contradicts universal absence.

passages.text: In the fictional Velvetquay depot at sunset, crate Neri was entirely inside room Saffron. Rooms Saffron and Indigo are disjoint rooms. Room Saffron is inside the west warehouse.

citations.quote: In the fictional Velvetquay depot at sunset, crate Neri was entirely inside room Saffron. Rooms Saffron and Indigo are disjoint rooms. Room Saffron is inside the west warehouse.

cases.label: supported
cases.rationale: Containment in Saffron and Saffron’s containment in the warehouse imply warehouse location.
